title: CallMessage
description: This enumeration represents the available call messages for interacting with the sov-bank module.

oneOf.description: Creates a new token with the specified name and initial balance.

initial_balance.description: The initial balance of the new token.

mint_to_address.description: The address of the account that the new tokens are minted to.

supply_cap.description: The supply cap of the new token, if any.

token_decimals.description: The number of decimal places this token's amounts will have.

token_name.description: The name of the new token.

oneOf.description: Transfers a specified amount of tokens to the specified address.

coins.description: The amount of tokens to transfer.

to.description: The address to which the tokens will be transferred.

oneOf.description: Burns a specified amount of tokens.

coins.description: The amount of tokens to burn.

oneOf.description: Mints a specified amount of tokens.

coins.description: The amount of tokens to mint.

oneOf.description: Freezes a token so that the supply is frozen

token_id.description: Address of the token to be frozen

oneOf.description: Updates the list of admins for a specified token.

new_admin.description:
The new admin address.
If `None`, the current admin entry for the transaction sender will be removed.

token_id.description: The ID of the token whose admin list is being updated.

oneOf.description: Transfers a specified amount of tokens to the specified address.

coins.description: The amount of tokens to transfer.

memo.description: The message included with the transfer

to.description: The address to which the tokens will be transferred.

Coins.description:
Structure that stores information specifying
a given `amount` (type [`Amount`]) of coins stored at a `token_id`
(type [`crate::TokenId`]).

SizedSafeString.description:
A String wrapper which enforces certain constraints to ensure it is safely displayable as part
of a transaction without confusing the user. Only printable ASCII is allowed, and the length is
limited.

`UniversalWallet` implementation is forbidden on `std::String` by default, to avoid the possibility
of untrusted input supplying highly confusing text that tricks users into misunderstanding the
transaction they are signing. `SafeString` enforces some constraints to mitigate this risk. If
you need to encode a large data blob such as a hex string, use a `Vec<u8>` with the
`[sov_wallet(display = "hex")]` attribute (or any of the other display styles). Avoid raw
`String`s if possible.
If an actual `String` is absolutely necessary, then a newtype wrapper can be used, on which
`UniversalWallet` is derived manually.
